messages:
maria (devex): Heads up: our edge sample fails during build with 'Unexpected token export' when using the monorepo pnpm layout. works in node. anyone seen exports/esm vs cjs issues with pnpm symlinks?
ryan (eng-runtime): yep — usually exports points to CJS or the package lacks conditional exports. edge bundlers pick ESM but fall back incorrectly if exports only maps to cjs.
sam (pkg-maintainer): our package.json had a lazy exports that mapped everything to dist/cjs. i think pnpm hoisting hid the missing dist/esm when testing locally.
jade (ts): quick fix is to add conditional exports: "import" -> ./dist/esm/index.js and "require" -> ./dist/cjs/index.js. also ensure "types" points to the surfaced entry so TS in a workspace resolves correctly.
maria (devex): pasted current exports: \"exports\": { \"./*\": \"./dist/cjs/*\", \".\": \"./dist/cjs/index.js\" } — oh no.
ryan (eng-runtime): yep that's it. change to conditional object for the root and avoid wildcard that overrides subpaths. also validate the published tarball contains dist/esm — pnpm local symlinks can mask publish-time omissions.
sam (pkg-maintainer): republished with exports fixed and types updated. added a prepublish script to assert both dist/esm and dist/cjs exist.
build-bot: deploy started (build 8951) :rocket:
maria (devex): redeployed edge sample — green now. adding checklist to sample-app README: include esm build, conditional exports, types entry, and verify tarball contents.
jade (ts): pro tip for monorepos: grep for bad patterns: rg '"\.": "./dist/cjs' --glob '!node_modules'
ryan (eng-runtime): if someone hits module resolution errors with pnpm hoists, temporary workarounds: public-hoist-pattern or --shamefully-hoist, but prefer fixing package exports.
maria (devex): thanks everyone. closing and leaving notes in the repo. :white_check_mark:
